# Works of the United States Government (US-PD)

The corpus files whose licence is `US-PD` are forms, publications and notices of the U.S. Internal
Revenue Service: works prepared by officers or employees of the United States Government as part
of their official duties.

17 U.S.C. 105(a): "Copyright protection under this title is not available for any work of the
United States Government, but the United States Government is not precluded from receiving and
holding copyrights transferred to it by assignment, bequest, or otherwise."

These files are therefore in the public domain in the United States. They are redistributed here
unmodified, as the IRS publishes them.

Sources:

- 17 U.S.C. 105: https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/17/105
- USAGov on the copyright of U.S. Government works: https://www.usa.gov/government-copyright
